_meta.why_self_contained: The shared contracts live in skills-shared and are bound into this repository through .agents/skills symlinks, which exist on a developer host and not on a GitHub Actions runner. A consumer gate that executed the shared checker would pass locally and fail in CI for an environment reason. So this layer asserts its own shape and records which shared contract it targets; conformance against the shared checker is a separate, host-bound check.
_meta.what_this_is_not: Not a copy of the shared contract. The laws below are the consumer-side subset that can be decided from this repository's own files.
